info.title: myli API
info.description: REST API of a self-hosted myli instance. Errors use RFC 9457 problem details.

put.description: Editors and admins, for shared recipes and their own private ones: editors can edit any shared recipe, whoever created it. Replaces all of the recipe's content, lines, steps and tags included, and records it as the next revision, with the message if there is one. Its owner and visibility stay, and its draft is discarded. Send the version the edit started from in `If-Match`: if someone changed the recipe or its draft meanwhile, the save is refused with 412.

schema.description: The `ETag` of the version the change is based on, such as `"3"`. Required: without it the answer is 428. A version that is no longer current gets 412.

parameters.description: The `ETag` of the version the change is based on, such as `"3"`. Required: without it the answer is 428. A version that is no longer current gets 412.
parameters.name: if-match

put.description: Whoever may edit the recipe: editors and admins, for shared recipes and their own private ones. Saves the content as the recipe's one draft, replacing any it had, while the published recipe stays as it is. Its photos and tags are checked as publishing them would be. It moves the recipe on to its next version: send the one it was based on in `If-Match`.

post.summary: Restore a revision of a recipe
post.description: Whoever may edit the recipe: editors and admins, for shared recipes and their own private ones. Publishes the revision’s content as the next revision, with the message “Restored from revision #n”, and records it in the audit log. History is never rewritten, and the draft stays. Tags deleted since are left out. Send the version it’s based on in `If-Match`, and `Content-Type: application/json` even though there is no body.

post.description: Editors and admins. The body is the file itself, with its type as `Content-Type`: a JPEG, PNG or WebP image of up to 10 MB, checked by its first bytes. It is turned upright, stripped of its metadata and resized. Until a recipe is saved with it, only its uploader can see it or use it, and it is deleted after a day.

413.description: The file is larger than 10 MB.

415.description: The file is not a JPEG, PNG or WebP image.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

get.description: Any signed-in user who may see the recipe it belongs to; until a recipe is saved with it, only its uploader. Anyone else gets 404, as for a photo that doesn’t exist. `width` is one of the widths in its `variants`. What an address serves never changes, so it can be cached for good.

200.description: The photo at that size, as WebP.

404.description: No photo has this ID or size, or the caller may not see it.

default.description: Any other error, as RFC 9457 problem details.

post.description: Admins. Allergen tags are a fixed list and are refused with status 409. Every recipe with the tag is indexed again, and an audit event records the change. Every recipe with the tag gets the other one instead, and the tag is deleted. The other tag must be of the same type.
